summary: AdminPage, AdminShell, ModerationQueue, UserSearch and MarketplaceQueue are rewritten on the Pulse kit against admin-1 / -2 / -3; everything above the returns is kept (Stats, queries and keys, decide / resolve mutations, debounce, sort, useAgo, useWide now exported, the forbidden gate, the partition math, lazy section render). Composition as the body scripts: Screen top=push width=wide > ScreenHeader section (ADMINISZTRÁCIÓ, ÁTTEKINTÉS, the Stílus stúdió TextLink, the only door to /admin/styles) > StatBlock + giant Numeral roll + SplitLegend stack beside it + SplitBar (G-data) > LedgerRow with pair (GYAKORLAT / MÉDIAFÁJL) in RowStack open close > Segmented cells with the lime count (rail of ListRows from 1024 up, R21) > the section > the liveness footer under a strong Rule with its figures in ink. Moderation: closed ListRows (name, e-mail, mono age · media, chevron), the open block between strong rules (display-face head with chevron up, UserPhoto at judging size, description, RoleKey, equipment stills, numbered steps, the one lime Jóváhagyás pill + Elutasítás link, the reject form). Accounts: SectionHeader, SearchField, mono sort keys, two-line ListRows. Piactér in the same grammar. AdminMetrics.tsx deleted with its 14 keys; budget 120 -> 0, deleted.

admin-1.reason: figures and owners are the frame data replayed from edited recordings (live: 49 users, 1660 exercises, other owners). Geometry: 74 compared, 61 matched, 13 deviating width-only (fill-width frame text boxes vs hugging runs; dy within 1 pt), 2 style notes = the two sentences whose figures are inked in text-1 and words in text-2 exactly as the frame segments (the comparator reads one colour per node), 0 unmatched.

admin-2.reason: frame data replayed (the second submission opened, override of _subcheck wrongItem). The frame is drawn scrolled 404 pt; the frame-height capture cannot scroll, so the probe reports every node 403-405 pt lower (R-S-admin-02). With that offset removed all text nodes are within 1 pt (residual dy -0.2 .. -0.8); the pair is cut from admin-2-tall at y 403. The submitted image is the seed blank upload (frame: barbell photo). Unmatched = rules / dots / glyphs the probe pairs by box (all visible in the pair).

admin-3.reason: frame data replayed (eight @pelda.hu accounts). Same scroll offset as admin-2 (R-S-admin-02); residual dy within 1 pt (the admin row 1.8). The illustrative letiltva flag of molnar.zsolt is not set: no recording holds a disabled account (schema-check ruling), so that one flag is absent in the pair; the code draws it. Style notes Fiókok / Placeholder are probe mis-pairings (the switch word, the visually hidden field label).

admin-figures-failed.note: stats 500: the skeleton stands during the client retries, then the figures are absent (as base)

probes: every captured state at 402 and 360: fonts loaded, pills <= 1 (the approve or the uphold pill), boxed surfaces 0, no overflow, targets >= 44, focus walk passes (5-18 stops). Geometry fails only for the reasons per frame.
